runners.comment: Unplaced in all seven Irish points, having completed only three times; rules debut today
runners.name: Betteryouthanme
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all seven Irish points, having completed only three times; makes very limited appeal on this rules debut.

runners.comment: Quite useful at best on the Flat but has regressed; ground a worry on hurdle debut
runners.name: Cavalry Call
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner; fairly useful at his best (1m-1m3f) but his form for Mike Smith since last summer has been disappointing, and the soft ground is a big worry on this hurdle debut; cheekpieces removed.

runners.comment: Useful on the Flat in 2024 but only previous hurdling attempt resulted in 42l defeat
runners.name: Dahab
runners.spotlight: Showed some useful Flat form in 2024 but his attempt at hurdling that year resulted in a 42l defeat, and he returned from a layoff with two down-the-field Flat runs in December/January; others have much less to prove.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten when 100-1 for recent hurdling debut
runners.name: Dublinofficecallin
runners.spotlight: Made fairly encouraging rules debut in Catterick bumper in December but was soundly beaten when 100-1 for recent hurdling debut.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie La Grugerie Et Al
runners.comment: Well beaten on first two hurdling starts
runners.name: Hourman
runners.spotlight: Beaten under 1l when last of four finishers in tactical Hexham bumper in the autumn but it's hard to weigh up what that form is worth and he was well beaten on both hurdling starts this year.

runners.breeder: E A R L De Faydeau
runners.comment: Close second on recent handicap debut at Kelso and has another big role to play here
runners.name: Lance Les Des
runners.spotlight: Three good runs this season, the latest a close second on handicap debut at Kelso (2m, heavy) three weeks ago; has another big role to play on this return to novice company.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; close second on last month's rules debut at Lingfield; big player
runners.name: Largy Go
runners.spotlight: Bought for big money after last year's winning Irish point debut and made pretty good start to rules career when keeping on well for close second at Lingfield (2m, heavy) last month; may not be seen to best effect until tackling longer trips but still has strong claims here.

runners.comment: Bought for £35,000 after wide-margin Irish point win in December; makes rules debut here
runners.name: Maiori
runners.owner: Up4b And Molly And Paul Willis
runners.spotlight: Out of a once-raced half-sister to a Group 1 Flat winner; left disappointing Irish point debut a long way behind when winning by 18l on soft ground in December, after which he was bought for £35,000; makes rules debut here.

runners.comment: 90,000euros 3yo; half-brother to to useful hurdlers; makes his debut here
runners.name: Minutes To Spare
runners.spotlight: 90,000euros 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother to useful hurdlers Came From Nowhere and Farfromnowhere; dam unraced half-sister to a bumper winner; looks interesting on paper but is entitled to benefit from this outing.

runners.comment: Pick of form gives him a good each-way shout but he disappointed when last in action
runners.name: Walk On Son
runners.spotlight: Only beaten about 2l when third of seven at Carlisle (2m1f, good) in October and has a good each-way shout if judged on that form but his 2m4f run the following month was a bit disappointing and he was pulled up (showed signs of post-race heat stress) when dropped back to 2m1f last time.

15:50.race_name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap Hurdle (Go North Sea Pigeon Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Scored over C&D on penultimate start; ran creditably at Musselburgh latest; solid claims
runners.name: Platin Moon
runners.spotlight: In-form contender who registered an account-opening success over C&D (heavy) on penultimate start and ran creditably at Musselburgh (good to soft) latest, both in Class 4 events; solid claims returned to Ayr and dropped back in grade.

runners.comment: Chance of following up her Newcastle win may depend on whether she gets another easy lead
runners.name: Shes Notjoeking
runners.spotlight: Belatedly regained the winning thread at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) but was able to dictate the pace; chance of following up may depend on whether she gets another easy lead.

runners.comment: Irish 6yo who justified market support at Hexham on last attempt over hurdles
runners.name: Nakassama
runners.spotlight: Irish 6yo who justified market support at Hexham (2m4f, good to soft) on last attempt over hurdles, opening his account; interesting back in this sphere, especially if again backed; tongue-tie fitted on return from layoff.

runners.comment: Low-mileage 7yo; made all at Ayr last time and looks open to further progress; respected
runners.name: The Coffey Boy
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who made all and held on narrowly from Velvet Vulcan in conditional jockeys' race at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last time, opening his rules account; raised 4lb but William Maggs, who keeps the ride, can use his 5lb claim this time; open to further progress in any case and looks likely to be as effective back down in distance; respected.

runners.comment: Went very close at Ayr in January/February; best to forgive latest effort; possibilities
runners.name: Velvet Vulcan
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner who showed best hurdles form when going very close at Ayr (2m4f, soft) in January/February and ties in with The Coffey Boy on the latter effort; had excuses (unsuited by the track and/or removal of hood) at Musselburgh since; has been taking a good hold and may benefit from this drop back in trip; possibilities.

runners.comment: Has weak claims on form but may improve now handicapping; heed the market signals
runners.name: Belvedere Bhoy
runners.spotlight: Has weak claims on form but is bred to do better, being out of a triple winner for his owner, and looks the type who could make that improvement now handicapping; market support would heighten interest.

runners.comment: Posted one of his better efforts when 11l third in this contest 12 months ago
runners.name: Bray Dale
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent maiden under rules but posted one of his better efforts when 11l third in this contest 12 months ago (last attempt over 2m); could go well, provided he takes to first-time cheekpieces.

16:20.race_name: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)

runners.comment: In career-best form last month (three wins) and still ahead of the handicapper
runners.name: Thank You Blue
runners.spotlight: In career-best form last month, completing hat-trick with dominant win from the front at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) eight days ago; effectively only 2lb higher here (due to go up another 6lb) and the longer trip will also suit; commands respect in current mood.

runners.comment: Close up in two small-field hurdles this year; makes handicap debut today
runners.name: Assertive Walk
runners.owner: Mrs P Bond Magniers Mrs P Shanahan
runners.spotlight: Very unexposed 6yo who has finished close up in two small-field hurdles this year (2m6f/3m); not obviously well treated for this handicap debut but has plenty of scope for improvement.

runners.comment: Just 1-8 over hurdles but has performed well on both outings this season; in the mix
runners.name: Gege Ville
runners.spotlight: Just 1-8 over hurdles but was placed on seasonal debut at Haydock (3m, good to soft) and his subsequent Uttoxeter fifth (2m4f, soft) was perfectly respectable; probably won't be far away

runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles but ran big race when second of 16 at Fairyhouse in January
runners.name: Chanceawetmorning
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but ran big race when second of 16 at Fairyhouse (2m4f, soft) in January and will be a tough nut to crack if in similar form here.

runners.comment: 3-3 since returning from break in December and open to more improvement over this new trip
runners.name: Kazar Forez
runners.spotlight: Safely held on first two British starts but has looked a different horse since returning from a layoff in December, winning three in a row (1m7f-2m1f); moves up in grade today but could quite plausibly have more improvement to come over the longer trip.

runners.comment: Very well suited by this C&D but might find others in this line-up better handicapped
runners.name: Follow Charlie
runners.spotlight: Gained three of his four hurdling wins over C&D, the latest off 3lb lower in November (soft ground); recent efforts have been respectable but he might find others in this line-up better handicapped.

runners.comment: Placed here in cheekpieces this season and again ran well in first-time visor last time
runners.name: Forest Blaze
runners.owner: M Blades Craggs Clark And Cambridge
runners.spotlight: Placed on consecutive starts in cheekpieces here (2m4f/2m3f) in December/January and again ran well when close second in first-time visor at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) on latest outing; contests this competitive race from a career-high mark but still enters calculations.

runners.comment: Won on seasonal debut and was clear second to handicap blot here on next outing; a player
runners.name: Red Cadillac
runners.spotlight: Came good with hard-fought success on seasonal debut at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) in November, his seventh start over hurdles, and bettered that performance when clear second to a handicap blot here (2m3f, soft) the following month; no surprise if he plays another major role.

runners.comment: Useful in his prime but out of form for new stable this season; had wind op; visor added
runners.name: Coconut Splash
runners.spotlight: Useful in his prime but has been out of form since returning from long absence for new stable in the autumn; needs combination of wind surgery and first-time visor to prompt a revival.

runners.comment: Showed nothing more than minor promise in his qualifying races; makes handicap debut today
runners.name: Largy Meadow
runners.spotlight: Showed nothing more than minor promise in three maiden/novice hurdles this year, the latest over C&D (soft; had wind op soon afterwards); needs to take a good step forward on this handicap debut.

16:53.race_name: Book The Coral Scottish Grand National Handicap Chase (Go North Red Rum Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Unreliable sort who comes here well below par; others are much preferred
runners.name: Good Work
runners.spotlight: Unreliable sort; jumped sketchily when a well-held fourth of seven in 3m Sedgefield handicap chase 16 days ago so others are much preferred.

runners.comment: Right back on track when a clear second over C&D 24 days ago; up 2lb but leading claims
runners.name: Torosay
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage mare who got right back on track (under today's rider Gregor Walkingshaw) when a clear second of 11 over C&D 24 days ago; up 2lb but she holds leading claims for yard back among the winners.

runners.breeder: E A R L Patrick Jobert Et Al
runners.comment: Cheekpieces on for chasing debut when improved second at Musselburgh latest; not dismissed
runners.name: King Horse
runners.spotlight: Cut little ice over hurdles but he took a big step forward (in first-time cheekpieces) on his chasing debut when second of six in 2m4f Musselburgh handicap 19 days ago; this lightly raced 6yo can't be dismissed on his first go over 3m with the headgear retained.

runners.comment: Course winner; tired late when second at Kelso three weeks ago; still enters calculations
runners.name: Nights In Venice
runners.spotlight: Course winner who comes here in decent nick, though he finished tired when second of seven in 3m2f Kelso handicap chase three weeks ago; he can race off a 2lb lower mark here so must still enter calculations.

runners.comment: Little show over hurdles but won Irish point so could still do better now going chasing
runners.name: Bennys Jenny
runners.spotlight: Offered little in a pair of bumpers for Stuart Coltherd and it's been a similar story in a pair of novice hurdles at Kelso (2m4f) and here (2m) either side of Christmas; has won an Irish point though so could still do better now going chasing, especially if the market vibes are positive.

runners.comment: Scored over hurdles here in 2023 but he remains winless over fences; had a wind operation
runners.name: Euchan Falls
runners.spotlight: Scored over hurdles here back in 2023 but he remains winless over fences and was tongue tied when pulled up over C&D in January; needs a subsequent wind operation to spark major improvement.

14:30.race_name: Betting And Gaming Council Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Arrives in pursuit of a four-timer; 8lb higher than last time but still respected.
runners.name: Followcato
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but a different proposition since switch to fences and fitted with cheekpieces, winning his last three, all right-handed and the latest by a wide margin when left clear mid-race at Hereford (2m5f, soft); 8lb rise in the weights will ask a question now back up in class, but still respected.

runners.comment: Improved since the cheekpieces went on and likely to make his presence felt again.
runners.name: Major Fortune
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner over hurdles; off the mark over fences at the seventh attempt at Wincanton (3m1f, soft) when fitted with first-time cheekpieces in January, and matched that level when runner-up at Newbury the following month; can make his presence felt again but he's never won off a mark this high.

runners.comment: Fell latest, but he's open to progress over fences and remains on a workable mark.
runners.name: Taita Hills
runners.spotlight: 2m4f handicap hurdle (soft) winner who shaped encouragingly on chase debut at Lingfield (2m, good to soft) in December when set a stiff task at the weights, and would have been placed returned to a more suitable trip at Newbury (2m7f) latest but for falling late; on a fair mark and remains open to progress in this sphere, so worth considering.

runners.comment: On a good mark and cheekpieces return but it's hard to be confident given his current form
runners.name: Begin The Luck
runners.spotlight: Five-time chase winner (2m1f-2m5f), latest at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day, but he's been well held in three subsequent runs and he was disappointing tried in blinkers latest; on a good mark and cheekpieces return but it's hard to be confident given his current form.

runners.comment: Two-time course winner who is respected now back at this venue, with rider's claim a plus
runners.name: River Run Free
runners.spotlight: Added a second course win when back on track in cheekpieces over 2m6f (good to soft) in January but, while running creditably off 5lb higher, failed to quite match that level when third at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) last month; respected back at this venue on better ground; now tried in blinkers, with Rian Corcoran's claim a plus.

runners.comment: Has thrived since returning from a break in December; very much a leading contender
runners.name: Eric Carmen
runners.spotlight: Has thrived since returning from a break in December, winning two of his three runs over hurdles before adding a third win of the season reverting to fences at Market Rasen (2m3f, soft) last month, each time under Benjamin Macey; he's up 4lb for last time but is very much a leading contender in current form.

runners.comment: Glimpses of promise but soundly beaten last time and he's a 22-race maiden under rules
runners.name: Ultra Viers
runners.spotlight: Remains a 22-race maiden under rules, 13 of them over fences, though has shown glimpses of promise and was still holding second when falling at the last at Market Rasen (2m5f) in November; failed to build on that at Lingfield later that month; returns from a three-month break with something to prove.

runners.comment: Sliding mark offers hope on old form but needs to rediscover spark
runners.name: Jack Doyen
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner (2m4f/2m5f) who has struggled for form since returning from a break in November and again failed to fire when well held at Wincanton nine days ago; sliding mark offers hope on old form but needs to rediscover spark.

runners.comment: Should have come on for last month's return from a long absence, but likely best watched.
runners.name: Flemenstide
runners.spotlight: Promising novice hurdler in 2021-22 season, but below par on final two starts for Paul Nicholls in 2022-23 and, unsurprisingly, shaped as if need of the run back from a mammoth absence on last month's chase debut; best watched at present.

runners.comment: More required off a career-high mark, but the step back up in trip may help; considered.
runners.name: One Last Glance
runners.owner: Fred Camis Ray Fielder & Mel Clarke
runners.spotlight: Rather in and out this season but he beat two other finishers in 2m4f contest on heavy ground here in February, and that success was no bolt from the blue; more is required off a career-high mark but the step back up in trip should suit and Freddie Mitchell's claim is a plus.

runners.comment: May have been lucky to win on chase debut last time, but she's respected off 2lb higher.
runners.name: Subtle Fortune
runners.spotlight: 2m6f soft-ground mares' novice hurdle winner at Uttoxeter in December 2024; struggled in a couple of handicap hurdles back from almost a year out, but made a winning chase debut, ridden by Darren Andrews, when left clear at Hereford (3m1f, heavy) last month; may have been lucky but respected off 2lb higher.

runners.comment: Open to further progress and holds strong claims in her bid for a Leicester hat-trick.
runners.name: Fay Ce Que Voudras
runners.spotlight: Opened her chase account at the seventh attempt when winning over C&D last month, and didn't have to improve to follow up off 4lb higher back here (2m4f, soft) a fortnight later; shoulders a 7lb penalty in her hat-trick bid, but she remains open to further progress back up in distance; strong contender.

runners.comment: Pulled up back from a break latest but he could resume progress if bouncing back.
runners.name: Esperti
runners.spotlight: Ran encouragingly on reappearance and won his next two starts, the second occasion at Fontwell (3m2f, good to soft) off 3lb lower in December; failed to fire when pulled up at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) after a two-month break a fortnight ago and needs to rediscover that earlier spark.

runners.comment: May need more for the win but he likes it here and another good run can be expected.
runners.name: Ronnies Reflection
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner (soft/heavy) last season and does appear to reserve his best for this venue, with last month's 3l second another respectable effort; likely to need a bit more to go one better off this mark, but has definite place prospects.

16:00.race_name: HMS Daring Royal Navy T45 Destroyer Mares' Handicap Chase (Challenger Mares' Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.breeder: H Fowler A Frost & C Longsdon
runners.comment: The clear form pick, now back in a handicap after two solid efforts in Listed company.
runners.name: Molto Bene
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Jumping And Ffl Bloodstock
runners.spotlight: Won handicaps in the autumn on first two chase starts (2m4f/2m7f, good/good to soft) and runner-up in Listed races on both outings since, over hurdles at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) and fences at Newbury (2m7f, good to soft); leading claims back in handicap company.

runners.breeder: E A R L De Cordelles Et Al
runners.comment: Yet to fire this term, but enters calculations on the pick of last season's efforts.
runners.name: Demoiselle Kap
runners.spotlight: Won first four starts for this yard, over hurdles and fences (2m-2m2f) last spring, then posted two solid placed efforts; shaped encouragingly on January's hurdling comeback, but failed to build on that when a 23l third at Catterick (1m7f, soft); still, she's worth considering eased 2lb back over fences.

runners.comment: Pulled up latest, but a bounce-back would not surprise; in good form earlier in season.
runners.name: Theonewedreamof
runners.spotlight: First three runs this season were solid, notably a win at Exeter (3m, good) in November followed by a close second over 2m4f at Cheltenham; disappointed at Hereford a week later, though, and pulled up on return from a two-month break 16 days ago, so now has something to prove; however, a bounce-back would not surprise.

runners.comment: Not at best since Fakenham win and hard to predict, but she's capable if in the mood.
runners.name: Gazette Bourgeoise
runners.spotlight: Built on November's promising reappearance when a wide-margin winner at Fakenham (2m5f, soft), but has failed to reproduce that level since and was pulled up at Taunton eight days ago; capable off this mark but she isn't the easiest to predict.

runners.comment: Needs to build on her effort following wind surgery last time, but that's possible.
runners.name: Taxus Baccata
runners.spotlight: Took a step back in the right direction when second, albeit beaten 18l, at Wetherby (2m3f, soft; tongue-tie applied) in January on stable debut and first run since wind surgery; another step forward will be required but that's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Cosy scorer at Ludlow 16 days ago; up 6lb but he still looks the one to beat
runners.name: Falco Des Pins
runners.spotlight: Ex-French recruit who gained a first success on just his third run over fences in 2m Ludlow handicap 16 days ago; up 6lb but he scored cosily there and looks the one to beat.

runners.comment: Better than of late when C&D third 22 days ago; he needs considering eased 2lb
runners.name: Lucky Lugger
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but he fared better than of late when third of eight over C&D 22 days ago; he needs considering eased 2lb.

runners.comment: Good fourth in 2m3f handicap at Market Rasen 33 days ago; ought to be in the shake-up
runners.name: Grain Trade
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over fences at Market Rasen (2m3f) in October and largely in good form since, fourth of seven in 2m3f handicap chase back there 33 days ago; ought to be in the shake-up again.

runners.comment: Solid start in this sphere with C&D fourth latest; no forlorn hope if building on that
runners.name: Urblereagh
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden hurdler who made a solid start in this sphere when fourth of eight in C&D handicap 22 days ago; he's no forlorn hope if building on that effort.

runners.comment: Blinkered when a very good C&D second latest; likely player if headgear has same effect
runners.name: Night Jet
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward in a change of headgear when second of eight in handicap over C&D 22 day ago, hindered by a blunder two out; this C&D winner is a likely player if blinkers have the same effect a second time.

17:03.race_name: Leicestershire And Derbyshire Yeomanry Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: Pulled up in a point latest, but a return to his best would put him firmly in the picture.
runners.name: Densworth
runners.spotlight: Useful handicapper over hurdles and fences as recently as 2024; finished well held on final two starts for Ben Pauling, albeit in strong handicap chases, and heavy defeat on stable/point debut last month following a break leaves him with something to prove; still, he'd be the one to beat on these terms if anywhere near his best.

runners.comment: Has something to find with Snipe on their Hereford run, but not entirely dismissed.
runners.name: A Jet Of Our Own
runners.spotlight: Showed useful form in hunter chases last spring, notably when finishing fifth over the big fences at Aintree (2m5f, good to soft); returned from break with a win at Larkhill in November, but has since been pulled up at Taunton and was tailed off behind Snipe at Hereford latest, which leaves him with a bit to prove.

runners.comment: Drops to 2m, but he's a leading contender with fewer questions to answer than most.
runners.name: Snipe
runners.spotlight: Made a bright start to hunter chases when beating Stattler (subsequent winner) at Hereford (2m5f, soft) in January and, although well beaten at Taunton (2m7f) when trying to match strides with Golden Son last month, he likely continues in form; leading contender dropped back to 2m for the first time, with fewer questions to answer than most.

runners.comment: Maiden point winner who will need to produce a career best to figure here.
runners.name: Calidad
runners.spotlight: 2023 maiden point winner who has yet to add to that success, though has shown ability over hurdles and fences; pulled up on last month's return from a long absence and although entitled to have come on for the outing, a career best will be needed to figure here.

16:26.race_name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap

runners.comment: Has not fired recently so has something to prove now
runners.name: Ludos Landing
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f winner in 2025 but has not fired in handicaps at Kempton (1m3f) and Chelmsford (1m6f) recently so has something to prove now.

runners.comment: Hinted at a revival with Southwell fifth latest; very much one to consider eased 2lb
runners.name: Traila
runners.owner: Katy Jane Reed And Edward J Ware
runners.spotlight: Quite lightly raced since 2023 (when a fairly useful 1m6f scorer) but he took a step back in the right direction when fifth of 11 in 1m4f Southwell handicap two weeks ago, doing best of those coming off a steady pace; very much one to consider off a 2lb lower mark.

runners.comment: Arrives on back of a very good Wolverhampton second; this dual C&D winner is a big player
runners.name: Market House
runners.spotlight: Scored twice over C&D last March and signalled he is ready to strike again when a very good second of six in 1m4f Wolverhampton handicap a week ago, staying on well having challenged wide; big shout off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Not disgraced with C&D seventh in October; comes here fit from hurdling so not ruled out
runners.name: Elemental Eye
runners.spotlight: A dual 1m6f/2m turf winner in 2025 who wasn't disgraced when seventh over C&D when last seen on the Flat in October; comes here fit from a spell hurdling so can't be discounted.

runners.comment: Beat just one over 1m2f here ten days ago; this course winner needs to get back on track
runners.name: Golspie
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with a good second at Southwell (1m3f) but he's failed to match it since and beat just one over 1m2f here ten days ago; this course winner needs to get back on track.

runners.comment: Yet to fire on AW this winter, retried in cheekpieces when tenth at Lingfield 13 days ago
runners.name: Green Team
runners.spotlight: Yet to fire on the AW this winter, retried in cheekpieces when tenth at Lingfield (1m5f) 13 days ago; he was a three-time winner at 1m4f/1m6f in the first half of 2025 but others are much preferred.

runners.breeder: Whitsbury Manor Stud And Mrs M E Slade
runners.comment: On a long losing run on the Flat but scored over hurdles in December; not dismissed.
runners.name: Freddy Robinson
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run on the Flat but he landed a 2m Market Rasen handicap reverted to hurdles in December; has gone well after a break too so not dismissed.

17:00.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: M Hanly C Hanly & M Buckley
runners.comment: Well backed when winning a Lingfield maiden (6f) five weeks ago; plenty more to come
runners.name: Bucklow Hill
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a Group 3 winner; justified market support when overcoming inexperience to beat Silent Strike in a 6f Lingfield maiden five weeks ago; open to improvement and he looks a strong contender.

runners.comment: Well held on 2yo debut but picked up well to win over C&D in January; plenty more to come
runners.name: Nursia
runners.spotlight: Last of five in an Ayr novice last summer (6f, good) but he left that form well behind when a comfortable winner over C&D six weeks ago, picking up well once extricating himself from a tight spot against the far rail; the runner-up has won a handicap off a BHA mark of 69 since so the form has some substance; more to come.

runners.comment: 2nd to Bucklow Hill on debut before an easy Kempton win (1-5f); open to further progress.
runners.name: Silent Strike
runners.spotlight: Sent off the 11-10 favourite for his Lingfield debut (6f) five weeks ago and made a pleasing start, albeit put in his place by Bucklow Hill; unextended when winning a Kempton maiden 16 days ago (1-5f; made all); clearly has plenty of ability but no obvious reason he would turn the tables on his Lingfield conqueror.

runners.comment: Impressed over C&D in November on 2nd start; this is much tougher but he is promising
runners.name: Cotai Lights
runners.spotlight: Midfield finish in a 1m novice at Chelmsford on his debut in November; left that behind when easily winning a C&D novice 16 days later; the form of that win hasn't really been bolstered but he was far too strong for his rivals and he shouldn't be underestimated despite today's stiffer opposition.

runners.comment: £150,000 half-brother to useful winner out of a well-related mare; 6f may be on sharp side
runners.name: Kimbara
runners.spotlight: £150,000 yearling; third foal; half-brother to 7f 2yo/1m4f winner Meribella (RPR 96); dam ran once (7f 2yo; 46), half-sister to winners Poet's Word (1m2f/1m4f Group 1); apprentice-ridden on debut; bred to be useful but probably over further and this looks decidedly warm for a humble £10,000 AW novice.

runners.comment: Overcame inexperience to win well on Southwell debut 4 months ago; bred to do better still
runners.name: Soul Love
runners.spotlight: Overcame inexperience to win a 6f fillies' maiden in decisive fashion on her Southwell debut four months ago; while the bare form looks nothing special, she's open to improvement and is bred to be smart; respected.

runners.comment: Promise for I Jardine as a 2yo; sold 7,000gns since latest; others have greater potential
runners.name: With Glory
runners.spotlight: Showed a fair level of ability in three sprint runs for Iain Jardine as a 2yo; sold for 7,000gns in October; receiving weight all round but others have much greater potential.

runners.comment: Drops in class but best at 1m4f and could get tapped for speed back at a mile
runners.name: Night Breeze
runners.spotlight: Still seeking a first AW success and he is better known for his exploits over middle distances; down in class but 1m is a query.

runners.comment: Strong C&D form this winter; 2lb rise for latest success manageable; high on the list
runners.name: Callianassa
runners.spotlight: She has refused to enter the stalls in two of her last four intended starts but strong form on the two occasions she has consented  to go in, third over C&D before beating a subsequent winner back here four weeks ago; 2lb rise no problem and she is high on the list.

runners.comment: Needs to step up on his 3 runs for this yard (2 in Dubai) but still relatively low mileage
runners.name: Carron
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins when trained by Charles Hills; only midfield off this mark at Kempton on his stable debut in December and twice a beaten favourite in Dubai this winter; still has time to do better and interesting to see if his backers return.

runners.breeder: G H S Bloodstock & J C Bloodstock
runners.comment: Two 7f wins for M Appleby last summer; low-key stable debut in January; opposable
runners.name: War Howl
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam
runners.spotlight: Won two 7f handicaps for Mick Appleby last summer; 20-1 for his stable debut here (7f) five weeks ago and he turned in a low-key effort; yard going well but he looks a risky proposition.

runners.comment: Yet to shine this year and handicapper proving slow to release his grip
runners.name: Good Morning Alex
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins on his record but he has finished down the field in three runs back from a break this year; only dropped 3lb for those defeats and he may need some more help from the handicapper.

runners.comment: Back to form when 2nd to a big improver at Southwell last week; solid claims off same mark
runners.name: Tribal Wisdom
runners.spotlight: Had a good spell in late 2025, winning three Tapeta handicaps at around this trip; good second to a well-handicapped opponent at Southwell last week; one to take seriously.

runners.comment: Fine year in 2025, winning four times; back from a three-month break in a competitive race
runners.name: Jez Bomb
runners.spotlight: Had a fine time of things in 2025, winning four times (including here); beaten off a lower mark on his last two starts though and he returns from a three-month break in a competitive race.

runners.comment: Thriving for new yard this winter; well suited to this C&D; should be in the thick of it
runners.name: Francesi
runners.spotlight: Joined Tony Carroll with a record of 1-44 but he's had a bumper winter, winning four times and finishing second on another four occasions; only midfield off this mark at Wolverhampton on Monday but returning to this track, where his record this winter reads 13121, offers hope of further progress.

runners.comment: C&D win in January but down the field behind Francesi three weeks ago
runners.name: Flying Fletcher
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways when dictating the pace in a C&D handicap in January; down the field behind Francesi three weeks ago; needs more.

runners.comment: Not easy to win with and could prove vulnerable stepping back up in class
runners.name: Starliner
runners.owner: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt
runners.spotlight: Not the easiest to win with and although he has been running respectably of late, he has more on his plate from just out of the handicap in a higher grade.

18:00.race_name: BetMGM Supports Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Improving all the time but 5lb penalty for last week's narrow win may leave him vulnerable
runners.name: Goldmoyne
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 6yo who has made giant strides for James Owen this winter, winning twice over 6f here in December and adding a 7f handicap at Southwell last week; penalty for that narrow success asks a stiffer question but foolish to discount further progress.

runners.breeder: Miss Nell Kent & Miss Sophie Bates
runners.comment: Can go well fresh and on a fair mark but headgear absent on this seasonal return
runners.name: Hectic
runners.spotlight: Has gone well fresh in the past and he still has some handicapping scope on form from not too far back; the absence of headgear (worn for last two wins) tempers enthusiasm slightly.

runners.comment: Bolted up on last Class 5 outing; conditions to suit and he holds each-way claims
runners.name: Al Muqdad
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; hit hard for his runaway success at Wolverhampton last November (last start in Class 5) but his C&D third one month later came off a 6lb higher mark than today's; each-way claims back down in grade.

runners.comment: Back to form in a visor of late, including a C&D win; should have another big run in him
runners.name: Golden Strike
runners.spotlight: Reinvigorated by a visor, winning a C&D handicap (beat Bobby Joe Leg) early last month before a close second at Southwell two weeks ago (Goldmoyne third); up another 2lb today but he threatened to be useful in his youth and should have another big run in him.

runners.comment: C&D regular and arrives in good order; no obvious reason he wouldn't run his race again
runners.name: Bobby Joe Leg
runners.spotlight: Age no barrier to his enthusiasm and he recorded the 17th success of his long career when gamely seeing off nine rivals over C&D in December; solid placed efforts here on his last two starts; in the mix again.

runners.comment: Two turf wins last season; easy lead unlikely now back from a four-month break
runners.name: Ey Up Its Jazz
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who won twice on slow turf last season, including a defeat of Al Muqdad at Thirsk in September (7f; meets his old rival on the same terms); unlikely to get an easy lead in this field and others look safer back from 132 days off.

runners.comment: Ready Class 6 win last month; finished lame latest; revised mark has now kicked in
runners.name: Sea Legend
runners.spotlight: Too strong for his rivals in a Class 6 over a mile here last month; reportedly finished lame when disappointing (13-8f) behind Golden Strike here four weeks ago; revised 3lb higher mark has now kicked in.

runners.comment: On a dangerous mark and latest C&D run was better than the bare figures; each-way shout
runners.name: Lessay
runners.spotlight: 2lb lower than for his Wolverhampton win in December and there have been some solid efforts in defeat since; latest C&D fourth wasn't without promise, and the faster they go early the better.

18:30.race_name: BetMGM Supports Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)

runners.comment: Quiet for new yard this winter but steps up in trip and drops into Class 5; check betting
runners.name: Dorney Lake
runners.owner: Mrs C M Clarke Foulrice Park Racing Ltd
runners.spotlight: Yet to shine for his current stable but he has dropped 8lb since December and is now eligible for this Class 5; steps up in trip and the betting can guide.

runners.comment: C&D win off this mark in November; awkward leaving the stalls in both runs this winter
runners.name: Blazing Son
runners.spotlight: His C&D win in November came off today's mark; two runs this winter have seen him start awkwardly but he'll be a threat to all if getting the start right.

runners.comment: 3-4 over C&D; last week's Southwell 4th isn't conclusive evidence the handicapper has him
runners.name: Flowstate
runners.spotlight: Only fourth off this mark at Southwell last week but this track seems to suit him ideally and he is 3-4 over C&D; not sure he is fully exposed at 7f just yet and he looks a major player.

runners.comment: Often ran well in defeat last year and did so again on 2026 return; others appeal more
runners.name: Beauty Choice
runners.spotlight: Went without a win in 2025 but often ran well; another serviceable effort when fourth of nine at Wolverhampton in January; others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: Two 1m wins here this winter; 3.5l behind Flowstate here 19 days ago
runners.name: Tasever
runners.spotlight: Two 1m wins here this winter but more to prove at this trip; 3.5l behind Flowstate here 19 days ago and others look better treated.

runners.comment: Nearly two years since his last win; edging down weights but needs to raise his game
runners.name: Chuzzlewit
runners.spotlight: Pushing two years since the second of his two wins for Kevin Ryan; continues to drop down the weights but he needs to raise his game to come out on top here.

runners.comment: Four 6f wins here this year; form dipped last time and others stronger over this trip
runners.name: Spartan Fighter
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner
runners.spotlight: Tough 9yo who has won four 6f handicaps here this year; form dipped last time, however, and returning to 7f isn't enough to tempt.

runners.comment: Course winner and shaped nicely after a break last month; stamina for 7f still not assured
runners.name: Andalprofit
runners.spotlight: Two wins in 6f handicaps, one of them here, and he made a pleasing return from a 12-week absence 20 days ago; stamina for 7f still to be conclusively proven.

19:00.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap

runners.comment: On up for current yard and scored cosily at Kempton four days ago; holds leading claims
runners.name: Moyowasi
runners.spotlight: On the up since joining his current yard this winter and bagged a second success in 1m Kempton handicap four days ago; had something in hand there so holds leading claims under a 5lb penalty.

runners.comment: Scored over 7f here after Christmas but looks to have gone off the boil; others preferred
runners.name: Wyvern
runners.spotlight: Scored over 7f here just after Christmas but kept very busy since and looks to have gone off the boil, failing to beat a rival over C&D ten days ago; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Back on track in first-time visor with Chelmsford third latest; very much one to consider
runners.name: Mr Fustic
runners.spotlight: Got back on track in a first-time visor when third of eight in 1m Chelmsford handicap last month; he's very much one to consider off a slipping mark with headgear retained.

runners.comment: Won over C&D before solid fourth of nine at Lingfield 13 days ago; possibilities
runners.name: Sold Out
runners.spotlight: Opened his account in classified event over C&D in February and not discredited back in handicap company when fourth of nine at Lingfield (1m) 13 days ago; possibilities despite 3lb weights rise.

runners.comment: Offered little for new yard when ninth here in December; he's hard to make a case for
runners.name: Take The A Train
runners.spotlight: Ended his time with Ed Dunlop under a cloud and he offered little for his new yard when ninth of 13 in 7f handicap here in December; he's hard to make a case for in his bid for a maiden victory.

runners.comment: C&D scored who backed it up with a good C&D fourth 15 days ago; ought to be thereabouts
runners.name: Dequinto
runners.spotlight: Finally got off the mark in classified event over C&D in February and he backed it up with a good fourth of nine in C&D handicap 15 days ago; races off a 5lb higher mark here but still ought to be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Little show in three runs for current yard, last of nine at Southwell two days ago
runners.name: Lisabetta
runners.spotlight: A fair winner at up to 9.5f for Timothy Doyle in Ireland in 2023 but lightly raced since and has shown little in three runs for her current yard, last of nine at Southwell (1m) two days ago; it's easy to look elsewhere.

19:30.race_name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Classified Stakes

runners.comment: Overcame all sorts of adversity to win at Wolverhampton on Monday; respected under penalty
runners.name: Classy Clarets
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism in a 6f 0-50 classified event at Wolverhampton on Monday but it was a tough watch for his supporters, rearing at the start, pulling hard in rear and then meeting some trouble in the straight; with that in mind, his 1l win was a fine effort and he has the raw ability to go well despite his penalty; dropping to 5f not sure to suit.

runners.comment: Visor/drop to 0-50 company saw him win easily at Southwell ten days ago; solid claims
runners.name: Fortunate Star
runners.spotlight: Took full advantage of the drop into this grade when comfortably seeing off Desert Master and six others at Southwell ten days ago (visored first time); has to shoulder a penalty as a result but he was capable of much better last year.

runners.comment: C&D winner but even that effort will need bettering if she is to take this
runners.name: A Lady Forever
runners.spotlight: C&D win in this grade last February; only midfield in a similar event two weeks ago and she will need a personal best to win in this field.

runners.comment: C&D winner; back to form when 2nd to Fortunate Star ten days ago; needs more today
runners.name: Desert Master
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; ran his best race for a while when chasing home Fortunate Star at Southwell ten days ago; wouldn't be sure to back it up and likely he will need a bit more in any case.

runners.comment: 6f win at this level here last March; yet to fire this year; others have stronger claims
runners.name: Doon The Glen
runners.spotlight: Scrambled home in a 6f classified event here 12 months ago; down the field in both starts in January; eased in grade but others have more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Ready Redcar win in her one previous run at this level; market useful back from a break
runners.name: Doralee
runners.spotlight: She has run in just one 0-50 classified race thus far and it resulted in her only win, namely a 2l success at Redcar last August (5f, good to firm); mixed bag afterwards and returns from 144 days off; not discounted.

runners.comment: C&D win on last run in this grade; major player back from an 80-day absence
runners.name: Lady Of The Garr
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; big player on her 2025 best and she was successful over C&D on her last foray into 0-50 company; absent 80 days but has run well after similar breaks in the past; withdrawn having got upset in the stalls on last intended outing.

runners.breeder: Oghill House Stud & Joseph M Burke
runners.comment: Won this race last year, his only success from 20 starts; in form this year; contender
runners.name: Shatin Venture
runners.spotlight: Poor strike-rate but his win came in the corresponding race 12 months ago and his penultimate second here came in a 0-65 handicap; likely to make another bold bid.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and penultimate run was encouraging; disappointed from wide draw latest
runners.name: Stroxx
runners.spotlight: Welcome signs of a revival when third over C&D in January but failed to fire at Wolverhampton three weeks ago (drawn wide); not a solid option.

20:00.race_name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Apprentice Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Five wins this winter, four over C&D; still improving and the one to beat under a penalty
runners.name: Yorkshire Glory
runners.spotlight: Making hay on the AW this winter, winning four C&D handicaps and taking his form to a new level with an easy win at Southwell ten days ago; 1lb well in under his penalty and his rider is excellent value for 7lb against other apprentices; the one to beat.

runners.comment: 0-13 but he has shown promise and dropping back in trip can help; more appealing than many
runners.name: Bullington Bry
runners.spotlight: 0-13 but he ran several good races for Jane Chapple-Hyam and his stable debut here (7f) two weeks ago wasn't a bad effort either; worth a crack at this trip and he is more appealing than many.

runners.comment: C&D winner but better known for his 7f exploits; will need a good pace dropped in trip
runners.name: Jkr Cobbler
runners.spotlight: Has won over C&D but better known for his 7f exploits; finished one place and 1.25l behind Call Glory here (7f) ten days ago when sent off favourite; stable form a plus but he will need a good pace back at 6f.

runners.comment: C&D win last month has been followed by two solid second place finishes; bang there again
runners.name: Pit Boss
runners.spotlight: Well backed when getting up late to win a C&D handicap last month; two solid runner-up finishes have followed and another prominent showing looks on the cards.

runners.comment: Two Southwell wins in January; third here ten days ago (7f); each-way shout
runners.name: Call Glory
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Southwell in January (6f and 7f); back at that level when a close third of ten in a 7f handicap here ten days ago; each-way shout.

runners.comment: Five-time C&D winner; on a fair mark and no surprise to see another big run
runners.name: Asadjumeirah
runners.spotlight: All five AW wins have come over C&D and there have been some near misses since the latest of them back in September; only midfield behind Yorkshire Glory at Southwell ten days ago but return to this track will suit.

runners.comment: Hold-up performer on a long losing run; others bring more convincing claims
runners.name: Rory
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer who needs the cards to fall right; losing run stretches back to July 2024 and others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: More encouraging signs on his last two starts but needs another step forward to take this
runners.name: Nazca
runners.spotlight: His handicap mark has bottomed out and there have been more encouraging signs on his last two starts, second in a 0-50 classified over C&D 15 days ago; more required today.

20:30.race_name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Apprentice Handicap (Div II)

runners.comment: Solid run of C&D efforts came to a crashing halt three weeks ago; may bounce back
runners.name: Teardrops
runners.spotlight: In good form here this winter before a lacklustre effort three weeks ago; capable of bouncing back but there are risks attached.

runners.comment: C&D win last month; fair 5f run one week later and he'll be happier back at this trip
runners.name: Howzak
runners.spotlight: Returned to form out of the blue when winning a C&D handicap last month (tongue tied first time); fair effort at Southwell (5f) one week later and he will be happier back up in distance.

runners.comment: C&D winner; arrives in good form and likely to be arriving on the scene late
runners.name: Hes An Angel
runners.spotlight: Off mark for new yard with a last-gasp success at Wolverhampton (6f) in January; unable to land a blow in a well-run 6f event back there 18 days ago but it was still a fair effort; likely to give another good account.

runners.comment: Back to a good mark now and a wind op in January looked to have helped last time; chance
runners.name: Bonito Cavalo
runners.spotlight: In blistering form two winters back, climbing from a BHA mark of 45 to 77; absent for 471 days prior to a 2025 campaign where he struggled; had a wind op in January and he hinted at a revival when beaten under 4l in a Class 5 here four weeks ago (5f); this looks more realistic and market confidence would look significant.

runners.comment: Returns from a 195-day absence without his usual cheekpieces; best watched
runners.name: Golden Prosperity
runners.spotlight: Two 6f turf wins last summer, both in classified company; no problem with the return to AW but back from a break perhaps not the time to catch him; all wins and bulk of his placed efforts have come in cheekpieces which are absent today.

runners.comment: C&D win last month came in a classified event; beaten fav (7f) on Saturday; needs more
runners.name: Sedgemoor
runners.spotlight: First-time blinkers saw him return to winning ways in a C&D classified event last month; beaten at short odds at Lingfield (7f) on Saturday; still has handicapping scope.

runners.comment: 0-36 for Linda Perratt and latest C&D second needs bettering back in a handicap
runners.name: Bernie The Bear
runners.spotlight: Still seeking a first win for Linda Perratt but he returned to form with a front-running second in a C&D classified event two weeks ago; more needed back into a handicap.

runners.comment: Conditions no problem but losing run gathering plenty of momentum; others look stronger
runners.name: Yaahobby
runners.spotlight: No problem with conditions but on a losing run and he needs to step up a level judged on recent efforts.
